mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.parent_user_id AS parent_user_id, r.student_user_id AS student_user_id, r.student_name AS student_name, r.mobile AS mobile, r.relation_desc AS relation_desc, cs.class_section_sp AS class_code_wecom FROM sys_school_family_contact r INNER JOIN sys_department d ON r.department_id = d.id INNER JOIN class_section cs ON d.name = cs.class_section_dsedj ORDER BY r.student_name ASC

SELECT DISTINCT r.parent_user_id AS parent_user_id, r.student_user_id AS student_user_id, r.student_name AS student_name, r.mobile AS mobile, r.relation_desc AS relation_desc, cs.class_section_sp AS class_code_wecom FROM sys_school_family_contact r INNER JOIN sys_department d ON r.department_id = d.id INNER JOIN class_section cs ON d.name = cs.class_section_dsedj WHERE r.parent_user_id IS NOT NULL AND r.parent_user_id != ''
AND ( r.student_name LIKE concat('%', #{queryNameTraditional}, '%') OR r.student_name LIKE concat('%', #{queryNameSimplified}, '%') )
AND r.mobile LIKE concat('%', #{queryMobile}, '%')
AND LOWER(cs.class_section_sp) LIKE concat('%', LOWER(#{queryClass}), '%')
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_student_match m WHERE m.student_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = #{studentId} AND m.user_id = r.parent_user_id AND m.student_user_id = r.student_user_id )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_student_match m WHERE m.user_id = r.parent_user_id AND m.student_user_id = r.student_user_id )
ORDER BY r.student_name ASC

SELECT DISTINCT sfc.id, sfc.department_id, sfc.parent_user_id, sfc.student_user_id, m.student_id AS student_id, sfc.student_name, sfc.relation_desc, sfc.mobile, sfc.create_time, sfc.update_time FROM sys_school_family_contact sfc INNER JOIN sys_department d ON sfc.department_id = d.id AND d.type = 1 INNER JOIN class_section cs ON d.name = cs.class_section_dsedj INNER JOIN ${studentProfilesDatabase}.student_info si ON si.class_section COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = cs.class_section_sp COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci INNER JOIN sys_student_match m ON m.student_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = si.student_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND m.user_id = sfc.parent_user_id AND m.student_user_id = sfc.student_user_id WHERE sfc.department_id IN
#{id}
